name: ISIC Archive API (skin lesion images)
summary: Search the International Skin Imaging Collaboration archive of dermoscopic and clinical skin-lesion images with diagnosis metadata, keyless over a documented OpenAPI REST API.
description: The ISIC Archive holds the public image collections behind the HAM10000 and ISIC challenge datasets that are popular on Kaggle. The v2 API lists collections and images, runs key:value search queries over clinical metadata (diagnosis, anatomical site, age, sex, image type) and returns direct file URLs and per-image licence and attribution. At check time the public image search reported 581,002 images in 63 collections.

auth.notes: Public images and collections answered without credentials; /users/me/ is for logged-in users.

endpoints.summary: Search images with a key:value query string, returns count and next cursor
One image with metadata and file URLs

license.name: Per image (copyright_license field: CC-0, CC-BY or CC-BY-NC per collection); the first 100 images checked were all CC-0

coverage.temporal: Archive of images collected over roughly the last decade; ongoing

agent_notes: Queries use Lucene-like key:value syntax with quoted values, for example diagnosis_1:"Malignant"; URL-encode the colon and quotes. Walk results with the next URL (cursor); limit above 100 was capped at 100. For bulk downloads the swagger page itself recommends the AWS Open Data snapshot (about 61 GB) or the isic-cli tool instead of paging this API. The /images/facets/ endpoint also answers but is not in the OpenAPI document.
caveats: Per-image licences vary; check copyright_license and attribution before reuse. Non-CC-0 values were not sampled.
No rate limit is documented; avoid bulk crawling.
Medical imaging data: not a diagnostic tool.

verification.notes: Example executed without credentials (200, about 0.5 s, CORS *). Collections, single image, similar, facets and the OpenAPI document (3.1.0) also answered 200. No User-Agent and the curl default both worked.
